results.description:
Heaven cast her out... but never let her go.

Five years in exile, Lin survives in the shadows as an illegal necromancer, raising the dead for desperate clients alongside her witch partner, Jinx. Her wings are broken, and her faith in justice shattered.

When a routine resurrection goes catastrophically wrong, Lin must seek help from Luc—a demon prince she has spent years avoiding, and the one person who has never stopped loving her.

Tracking the rogue spirit uncovers buried truths about both angels and demons, and as old secrets come into into the light, Lin realizes her Fall may be tied to something far greater than she could have imagined.

A dark paranormal romance, FIRST DANCE is a story of broken wings and forbidden devotion.
